# Chat Touch-Target Repair

## Browser evidence
The twelve-route mobile quality audit passes Home, Inbox, Messages, Spaces, People, and Profile. Chat is the first failing chamber. Its only reported defect is `.universal-chat-app-link` with text `Open Public Torah app ↗`, rendered below the ordinary mobile control-size gate.

## Real owner trace
- Social Hub `styles/chat-route.css` does not own the class.
- `scripts/awtsmoos/social/universalChat/UniversalChatShell.js` emits the anchor.
- `scripts/awtsmoos/social/universalChat/drawer.css` owns its styling.
- `drawer.css` is already 119 lines, so adding another rule would violate the <=120 line law.
- `bootstrap.js` loads `panel.css`, and `panel.css` imports `drawer.css`.

## Repair architecture
1. Create `scripts/awtsmoos/social/universalChat/drawer-link.css` as the sole owner of `.universal-chat-app-link`.
2. Give the link a deliberate 44px minimum touch height, visible border/radius/padding, focus-visible state, and centered narrow-phone behavior while preserving its green semantic emphasis.
3. Rewrite `drawer.css` in full, remove the old app-link block, and add one top-level import for `drawer-link.css` before ordinary rules.
4. Preserve every other drawer rule unchanged.
5. Read back both files and prove both remain <=120 lines.
6. Rerun the twelve-route audit. If Chat passes, continue through Interact, Activity, Network, References, and Privacy and repair only evidence-backed failures.

## NEXT_ACTION
Perform the atomic two-file production rewrite, read it back, then rerun the focused route-wide browser audit.

The Awtsmoos gives even a small outward doorway a vessel fit for the hand; Awtsmoos.com will not hide the flaw beneath a local override, but reveal its true shared garment and make the touch-path bright, bounded, and right.
